subject.title: bug(agents): nodes tool describe action fails with 'node required' due to schema/implementation mismatch

question: What should the agent-facing `nodes` tool do when `action: "describe"` omits `node`?
rationale: The source bug is clear, but choosing default-node fallback versus discovery output changes multi-node agent behavior and the issue discussion includes viable alternatives.

options.title: Confirm default-node describe
options.body: Treat omitted-node `describe` as a read-only lookup through the existing default-node picker, then require regression coverage and real behavior proof before merge.

options.title: Use list-style discovery
options.body: Make omitted-node `describe` return node-list style discovery data, avoiding implicit target selection in multi-node setups at the cost of a broader output-contract change.

options.title: Require explicit node
options.body: Keep `describe` target-specific and instead tighten the model-facing schema or prompt contract so agents know `node` is required.

recommendation.title: Confirm default-node describe
recommendation.body: Treat omitted-node `describe` as a read-only lookup through the existing default-node picker, then require regression coverage and real behavior proof before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: He has the strongest history on both the flattened nodes tool schema and the default-node resolver used by the open fix path.
